subject.name: Physics
subject.examPattern: Extended: Paper 2 MCQ 45 min, 40 questions (30%) + Paper 4 Theory 1 h 15, 80 marks (50%, ~6–10 structured questions) + Paper 6 Alternative to Practical 1 h, 40 marks (20%) or Paper 5 Practical Test. Core uses P1 + P3. Grades A*–G.
